meta_description:
1,257 likes, 13 comments - unicef on October 28, 2026: "In Chad, the lack of water and essential services in refugee camps puts children at risk of contracting polio.

Mamouna, a UNICEF-supported vaccinator, visits families and ensures their children receive life-saving immunization – bringing relief to mothers like Nannoya.

“If children are vaccinated, they won’t suffer from certain illnesses,” she says.

#WorldPolioDay".
